messages:
sarah: Quick PSA 1A Atlas (the office bearded dragon) discovered the tiny suede couch in meeting room B and is now claiming it as his throne. photos incoming 432
photo-bot: sarah uploaded 2 files
diego: love that for him. does he accept tea and biscuits or only crickets? 60B
remy: he once politely nibbled my pencil. i take that as endorsement of my work.
sarah: he prefers carrot coins these days. also he gives very slow blinks which i interpret as approval.
ops-bot: gentle reminder: pets in common spaces must follow the office pet policy. please ensure Atlas is on leash when in shared rooms and that heat lamp cords are secured.
diego: noted. tiny throne assessment: 8/10 ergonomics for scaly backs. should we make him an honorary sticker for his spot?
remy: sticker idea: "Atlas: Warmth Curator" with a tiny crown. also petition to add a stuffed cactus to his couch.
sarah: poll: Bring Atlas to next all-hands as a morale cameo? options: No way / Brief cameo / Full royal procession
ops-bot: poll created: "Atlas for All-Hands?" (No way / Brief cameo / Full royal procession)
diego: voted Brief cameo 44D
remy: voted Full royal procession (i will choreograph entrance music) 3B6
sarah: will check with people-ops and with Atlas (he communicates via tail wiggles). final note: Atlas steals warm laptop sleeves, do not leave them unattended. end thread.
